Measured data point (same session as the filing, `session_01GYwKNq9YMPW3Wg4jJs4ZpS`, on maintainer follow-up 「你现在能检测自己的模型吗」): a live probe was attempted this time. ToolSearch for session-introspection tools (`get_session` / session context / model) returned **no such tool in this harness shape** — only unrelated tools matched. The only reading available is the system prompt's **configuration declaration** (configured model `claude-fable-5`, fallback chain `claude-opus-5[1m]` → `claude-opus-4-8[1m]`), which the prompt itself says may differ from the serving model — i.e. self-report, inadmissible under the fuse rule.

So the gap is now measured, not just inferred: the `get_session` dual-reading probe that passed the gate in the 2026-08-27 manual session is **absent** in at least one scheduled/remote session shape. Any canonical probe blessed by the fix must either (a) be available across session shapes, or (b) explicitly scope the adjudication channel to session shapes where the probe exists — with the documented fallback (skip, maintainer path) for the rest.

Maintainer direction (live session 2026-08-27, same session `session_01GYwKNq9YMPW3Wg4jJs4ZpS`), quoted verbatim: 「所以使用 routines 已经不是最佳方案了。还是得考虑直接会话的模式」.

This widens the card's scope from "bless a probe" to **re-deciding the seat-operation transport**. Two measured defects on the scheduled shape, with different blast radii:

1. **Tier fuse unverifiable** (measured in this session): no session-introspection tool in the scheduled shape ⇒ the adjudication channel and any tier-gated duty can never legally run there. Affects only tier-sensitive duties.
2. **Scheduler reliability** (measured 2026-08-26→27): a dead round at 18:05Z followed by ~12h of zero fires until a manual summon. Affects all scheduled duties.

Note the Routine's core benefits (fresh session, zero local state, behavior versioned in git, idle-round cost ceiling of one query) are properties of the **protocol**, not the timer — the 2026-08-27 manual daily round slotted into the mutex/seat-post discipline cleanly and passed the tier gate.

Options for the skills seat to carry into the decision:
- **A (triage seat's recommendation): layered hybrid.** Keep the scheduled channel for tier-agnostic mechanical duties (hourly sweep, unlock scan, half-state healing); move tier-sensitive duties (proxy-adjudication, contract-review-tier work, director triad) wholly to maintainer-summoned direct sessions — aligned with the director seat already being manual-summon by design, and with the maintainer's periodic decision-box review cadence, so the added latency on adjudicable cards is ≈0.
- **B: full direct-session mode.** Verifiable model and live interjection, but every fire then depends on a human or a long-lived session surviving container reclaim / usage walls / expiry — re-adding the operator toil the Routine pilot existed to remove.
- **C: wait for platform introspection in the scheduled shape.** Outside our control; not a plan.

Either A or B is a governance-face protocol change (SKILL.md seat-Routine principles + the adjudication-channel clause) — skills-lane PR, maintainer ruling required; this comment records direction and analysis, not a ruling.

Tier analysis for the mechanical trio (maintainer question in the same live session: 「小时增量 sweep、解锁扫描、半标注治愈,这些需要什么档位」) — input for option A's split:

- **Half-state healing**: pure label-set convergence per the state-machine vocabulary; self-correcting via the next patrol. **sonnet floor suffices.**
- **Unlock scan**: grep `Blocked-by:` + verify upstream closure are mechanical; the re-verify-on-merged-ref step (did the upstream merge also fix this card?) reads diffs — **opus is the safe tier**, sonnet marginal.
- **Hourly incremental sweep (first-touch classify/route)**: reads code to find the fix landing point, assigns domain/type, grades queue vs decision-box vs close. Judgment work; the expensive error direction (a decision-worthy card slipping into `pm:queue`) is fenced by the human-floor list and the "unclear landing point ⇒ leave at first touch, never guess" rule, not by tier. **opus — the default judgment tier.**

All three run in one session ⇒ the scheduled round needs **opus**, max. None of the three is behind the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` hard gate, so the "tier fuse unverifiable in scheduled shape" defect does not apply to them at all — which is the premise that makes option A coherent. Consequence if A is ruled: the scheduled triage Routine's fable pin becomes unnecessary (its only fable duties — proxy-adjudication and contract-review — move to direct sessions); re-pinning the Routine to opus in the Routines UI is a maintainer action and a straight fable-quota saving. Existing compensating control unchanged: governance-face work built at opus still reaches the maintainer only through a fable-tier review seat.

**Maintainer ruling** (live session 2026-08-27, session `session_01GYwKNq9YMPW3Wg4jJs4ZpS`), quoted verbatim — supersedes the A/B/C option framing above:

「但是 代裁、Clause-②/契约复审也是很重要的职责，也是需要定时处理的，我不希望分诊拆的这么散。我觉得分诊也和普通项目经理一样走普通的session，然后需要高级别处理的任务走 fable 子agent，然后自己默认定时1小时，除非人工要求。」

Ruled shape:
1. **The triage seat stays whole** — no splitting duties across transports. Triage runs as a normal direct session, same shape as execution PM seats.
2. **Tier-gated duties (proxy-adjudication, Clause-②/contract-review) are handled from within that session by dispatching a `claude-fable-5` subagent**, model passed explicitly per dispatch — the same explicit-tier-param mechanism dispatch already uses, so the gate control becomes the dispatch parameter, not session self-introspection. (The adjacent closed finding on `get_session` measuring the dispatching process stands; the ruled mechanism does not rely on introspection at all.)
3. **The session self-schedules at a default 1-hour cadence**, overridable by explicit maintainer request.

Implementation notes for the skills seat (protocol text still lands via a skills-lane PR; this card carries the ruling):
- SKILL.md sections touched: 「座位 Routine 三原则」 (retire or rewrite for the triage seat), the adjudication-channel hard-gate clause (runner = fable **subagent** dispatched with explicit `model`, replacing "Routine 钉档" as the tier control), and the contract-review runner wording if it names the Routine.
- Timer-text discipline and mutex four-readings apply unchanged — they are transport-agnostic and already survived manual sessions.
- Operational caveat recorded honestly: a self-timed session dies with its container / usage walls; succession is by maintainer summon (「除非人工要求」), and the seat-post mutex protocol already handles succession.
- The claude.ai Routine `trig_01XhwLupWiUBp7GUEigK1RFW` becomes obsolete under this ruling — disabling it in the Routines UI is a maintainer action (avoids double-firing cost; mutex would serialize correctness either way).

Effective immediately in the current seat session per the maintainer's live authorization; codification follows via the skills lane.

**Maintainer ruling recorded — the five-piece codification package is approved whole.** Director seat, 2026-08-27 (session `session_01MnijPVVDakqK2J335JoJtq`, tier machine-read `claude-fable-5`). Verbatim: 「**同意，重新汇总给我解释一下新的分诊项目经理完整的工作。**」 — approving the package as presented in the live Director session, which refines the 14:07Z ruling on this card with three additions the discussion produced:

1. **Triage = normal direct session, whole seat at opus** (mechanical trio needs at most opus; the 14:07Z ruled shape stands).
2. **Tier-gated duties (proxy-adjudication, Clause-②/contract-review increments) run via a `claude-fable-5` subagent dispatched with explicit `model`** — unchanged from 14:07Z — **plus (new) the transcript tier verification**: before any verdict is adopted or any label cleared, the dispatching session greps the subagent's transcript for the per-message API-stamped `model` field; every verdict-producing turn must read `claude-fable-5`; fallback evidence ⇒ the verdict is void (redo or maintainer path). This reconciles the ruled mechanism with the downgrade-fuse doctrine — the reading measures SERVING, the dispatch param alone is configuration (fallback chains are real and measured; a fable-pinned session read back `claude-opus-5` under quota pressure 2026-08-26 07:39Z).
3. **(New) The no-edit guardrail**: the opus parent has exactly two legal actions on a fable subagent's verdict — adopt verbatim, or void whole (void reasons are mechanical only: tier verification failed / scope exceeded / format incomplete). ⛔ Never rewrite, trim, or "improve" the verdict content — a lower-tier node silently editing higher-tier judgment is the one real seam this design opens, and this closes it. Acceptance = evidence checklist (scope, machine-checkable citations, tier read), never substantive re-judgment; substantive backstops stay where they are (代裁清单 in every round report for the maintainer; governance faces still reach the maintainer only through a fable review seat + human merge).
4. **(New) Self-timer default = armed at round END, delay ≤55 minutes** (the 1-hour prompt-cache TTL minus measured minutes-level timer jitter keeps the whole shift on one unbroken cache chain; two recorded boundaries: usage-overage drops the TTL to 5 minutes and the benefit to zero, and compaction rounds rewrite regardless — neither changes the default). Overridable by explicit maintainer request, per the 14:07Z ruling.
5. The old scheduled Routine (`trig_01XhwLupWiUBp7GUEigK1RFW`) is obsolete — its UI disable is filed as its own `pm:awaiting-maintainer` item.

**State**: `finding` → `pm:queue` in the same stroke (grading: the card now carries a complete ruling and is dispatchable protocol work; skills lane; fable — SKILL.md is on the clause-① surface). **Serial constraint**: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` and `references/lanes/director.md` are held by open draft PR #12713 (#12709, awaiting the maintainer's human merge) — this card dispatches only after #12713 merges. File surface at dispatch: SKILL.md (座位 Routine 三原则 rewrite to the direct-session self-timed shape; the adjudication-channel runner clause) + `references/contract-review.md` (the 资格/反模式 paragraphs: subagent review becomes legal WITH transcript tier verification) + `references/lanes/director.md` cross-references if touched.

**Ruling increment — piece 6 approved: the chain's timed-processing split.** Director seat, 2026-08-27 (session `session_01MnijPVVDakqK2J335JoJtq`). Maintainer, verbatim: 「**同意，继续**」 — approving the ownership split presented in the live session:

- **Authority and accountability stay with the Director seat** (the seat's founding sentence 「负责处理 contract-review 类别的」 unbroken); **timed processing moves to the triage seat's ~55-minute rounds** (per the maintainer's own 「契约复审也是很重要的职责，也是需要定时处理的」).
- Triage per round: enumerate carriers → transcript-verified fable subagent reviews the contract increment → PASS ⇒ 清标即落地 for un-governed code / the draft four-piece for governed faces → FAIL ⇒ label-flip handback → BLOCKED-on-decision ⇒ decision inbox only, ⛔ never self-ruled. Every round report carries the 复审清单 (same mandatory-audit shape as the 代裁清单).
- Director on summon: consolidated chain inventory; processes ONLY carriers triage has explicitly parked, failed tier-verification on, or aged out — plus the BLOCKED branch inside adjudication batches.
- **Anti-double-run rule (hard)**: the standing processor is uniquely the triage timed round; the Director never sweeps the same carrier set in parallel — two seats clearing the same labels is a write race by construction.

Codification scope grows accordingly: `references/contract-review.md`'s **归属条款** rewrites alongside the 资格/反模式 paragraphs (常设 = triage timed rounds via transcript-verified fable subagent; Director = summon-time backstop + BLOCKED branch; the 2026-08-27 quotes carried); `references/lanes/director.md` 职责一 adjusts to the backstop framing. The five pieces recorded 2026-08-27 earlier on this card stand unchanged. Serial constraint unchanged: dispatches after PR #12713 merges.
